Module A: the data and coding layer

Exploration notebook, module A: existing outputs only, no new analysis

A tested warehouse (54 dbt models, 10 seeds, 126 tests) sits behind every number. This notebook looks at what the data layer shows before any model: reporting completeness, spending, the timeline of events and the pipeline.
